g.text: Cellpose-SAM: 2D segmentation time and mask agreement

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #64748b

g.text: Full inference includes preprocessing, network, dynamics, flow quality control and mask cleanup

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #64748b

g.text: Object agreement: smaller of reference/prediction mean IoU after one-to-one matching at IoU >= 0.5; unmatched cells count as zero.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #64748b

g.text: Agreement measures similarity to standard inference, not ground-truth accuracy. Exact mode matches mask bytes; fast mode can change boundaries and counts.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #64748b

g.text: Medians of 5 synchronized repeats; whiskers: min-max. Standard/exact batch: 8; fast batch: 32. RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #64748b

g.text: Default bfloat16 standard network versus FP16 fast network. Model loading, image decoding and initial FP16 cache creation excluded; shared GPU.
